freeze_timing: Frozen after Phase-6 completion but before Phase-7 and Phase-8 adjudications are visible.

dwell_tau_selection.basis: Locked canonical reference from pre-Phase-6 evidence: Phase-4/5 fixed tau=3 was the robust d3 minimum. Phase-6 is not used to choose the dwell law or tau for Phase 9.

CONSISTENT_DIRECTION_NOT_ROBUST.choice_rule: continuous if both fixed/geometric median Delta_reset >0; line_reset if both <0

ORDER_EQUIVALENT_ALL.reason: retain current/simple production ordering under equivalence

ORDER_DIRECTIONALLY_CONSISTENT.choice_rule: POST if all four median Delta_order >0; PRE if all four <0

phase9_reporting.primary_panel: always run sealed 24-metric panel on the canonical selected pipeline versus CIPHER_ONLY if Phase-8 replication guard passes
phase9_reporting.causal_architecture_claim: requires reset resolved=true and ordering resolved=true in addition to Phase-9 confirmatory broad improvement
phase9_reporting.unresolved_sensitivity: If reset or ordering is unresolved, run the predeclared alternate sensitivity but never switch the primary pipeline based on Phase-9 scores.

no_tuning: no Phase-9 metric feedback into dwell/reset/order choice
no substitution of geometric/semi dwell after Phase-6 result
